Hi,

sorry for the late reply.

I deleted your "True Souce" page, although I've been thinking for a second to just correct it to True Sauce. :D

There is already a True Source page which is redirected to the One Power page.
https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/True_Source

The first few sentences of the One Power page and the paragraph Nature of the True Source explain the True Source well enough, so I think it's unnecessary to create a short page for the True Source separately, since you can look the keywords up and get the info right away.

Keep continue editing, but please check before you create something whether there's already a page for that. It would be also nice if you could learn to keep the style of the existing pages, e.g. the use of "short page box, Notes box, links and references". Check my contributions if you need a reference. 

I would also need to ask you to please restrain yourself from using photos from unknown sources. Copyright restrictions require us to only use pictures from known sources and with proper crediting. If you would be so kind you could start crediting or removing the photos you've uploaded so far. Thank you.
Overall, I'd recommend to read the https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Policies and the https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Contents section for more info. 

If you are uncertain, you can try to leave a message to me, I'll try to visit a bit more often. ;)

Best,

S.
